title: Freeness of localized KHT Shimura cohomology with algebraic local systems from residual Galois irreducibility
difficulty_reason: After reusing old2148 and Sections3.1-3.2, and accepting the named local representation/nearby-cycle tools, the author compares two integral computations at mixed Iwahori/infinite level to force a nonzero torsion lattice cokernel and track its nongeneric constituents. The two extremal lattices in the same characteristic-zero space are then shown nonisomorphic. Using the named Scholze typical factorization as an input, the second global filtration is exchanged toward the first; the persistent integral obstruction forces a matching Galois character shift and a strictly growing interval of residual Frobenius eigenvalues, iterated until a full Zelevinsky line contradicts its dimension. The coupling of integral lattice obstruction, constituent control and global-filtration spectral growth supports one H3 beyond the old generic-constituent exclusion. The typical factorization, elementary lattice swap and final finite-set counting are not independently credited constructions.
